Representative_Docs: ["their task being caught by the guard or patrol by night or for tak any thing from the master' yard without leave for these and the like crime the slave are whip thirty-nine lashe and sometime seventy or a hundr on the bare back one slave who was under my care was whip i think one hundr lashe for get a small handful of wood from his master' yard without leave i heard an overseer boast to this same master that he gave one of the boys seventy lashe for not doing a job of work just as he thought it ought to be done the owner of the slave appear to be pleas that the overseer had been so faithful the apology they make for whip so cruelly is that it is to frighten the rest of the gang the master say that what we call an ordinary flog will not subdue the slave hence the most cruel and barbarous scourging ever witnes by man are daily and hourly inflict upon the nak body of these miserable bondmen not by master and negro-driver only but by the constable in the common market and jailor in their yard when the slave are whip either in public or private they have their hand fasten by the wrist with a rope or cord prepar for the purpose this being thrown over a beam a limb of a tree or someth else the culprit is drawn up and stretch by the arms as high as possible without rais his foot from the ground or floor and sometime they are made to stand on tip-toe then the foot are made fast to someth prepar for them in this distort posture the monster fly at them sometime in great rage with his implement of torture and cuts on with all his might over the shoulder under the arms and sometime over the head and ears or on part of the body where he can inflict the greatest torment occasionally the whipper especially if his victim does not beg enough to suit him while under the lash will fly into a passion utter the most horrid oath while the victim of his rage is cry at every stroke lord have mercy lord have mercy the scene exhibit at the whip post are awfully terrific and frightful to one whose heart has not turn to stone i never could look on but a moment while under the lash the bleed victim writhe in agony convuls with torture thirty-nine lashe on the bare back which tear the skin at almost every stroke is what the south call a very moderate punishment many master whip until they are try until the back is a gore of blood then rest upon it after a short cessation get up and go at it again and after hav satiat their revenge in the blood of their victim they sometime leave them tie for hour together bleed at every wound sometime after being whip they are bath with a brine of salt and water now and then a master but more frequently a mistress who has no husband will send them to jail a few days giv order to have them whip so many lashe once or twice a day sometime after being whip some have been shut up in a dark place and deprive of food in order to increase their torment and i have heard of some who have in such circumstance died of their wound and starvation such scene of horror as above describ are so common in georgia that they attract no attention to threaten them with death with break in their tooth or jaws or crack their head is common talk when scold at the slave those who run away from their master and are caught again generally fare the worst they are generally lodg in jail with instruction from the owner to have them cruelly whip some order the constable to whip them publicly in the market constable at the south are generally savage brutal men they have become so accustom to catch and whip negro that they are as fierce as tiger slave who are absent from their yard or plantation after eight o'clock p m and are taken by the guard in the city or by the patrol in the country are if not cal for before nine o'clock a m the next day secur in prison and hardly ever escape until their back are", "county virginia now a local preacher of the methodist episcopal church in portage co ohio testify as follow in or one of my father' slave was accus of tak the key to the office and steal four or five dollar he deny it a constable by the name of hull was cal he took the negro very deliberately tie his hand and whip him till the blood ran freely down his legs by this time hull appear tir and stop he then took a rope put a slip noose around his neck and told the negro he was going to kill him at the same time drew the rope and began whip the negro fell his cheek look as though they would burst with strangulation hull whip and kick him till i really thought he was going to kill him when he ceas the negro was in a complete gore of blood from head to foot mr david hawley a class-leader in the methodist church at st alban' lick county ohio who move from kentucky to ohio in testify as follow in the year or i saw a slave hung for kil his master the master had whip the slave' mother to death and lock him in a room threaten him with the same fate and cowhide in hand had begun the work when the slave join battle and slew the master samuel ellison a member of the society of friend formerly of southampton county virginia now of marlborough stark county ohio give the follow testimony while a resident of southampton county virginia i knew two men after hav been severely treat endeavor to make their escape in this they fail were taken tie to tree and whip to death by their overseer i live a mile from the negro quarter and at that distance could frequently hear the scream of the poor creature when beaten and could also hear the blow given by the overseer with some heavy instrument major horace nye of putnam ohio give the follow testimony of mr wm armstrong of that place a captain and supercargo of boat descend the mississippi river at bayou sarah i saw a slave stak out with his face to the ground and whip with a large whip which laid open the flesh for about two and a half inche every stroke i stay about five minute but could stand it no longer and left them whip mr stephen e maltby inspector of provision skeneatele new york who has resid in alabama speak of the condition of the slave says i have seen them cruelly whip i will relate one instance one sabbath morn before i got out of my bed i heard an outcry and got up and went to the window when i saw some six or eight boys from eight to twelve year of age near a rack made for tying horse on the public square a man on horseback rode up got off his horse took a cord from his pocket tie one of the boys by the thumb to the rack and with his horsewhip lash him most severely he then unty him and rode off without say a word it was a general practice while i was at huntsville alabama to have a patrol every night and to my knowledge this patrol was in the habit of travers the street with cow-skin and if they found any slave out after eight o'clock without a pass to whip them until they were out of reach or to confine them until morn mr j g baldwin of middletown connecticut a member of the methodist episcopal church give the follow testimony i travel at the south in when near charlotte n c a free color man fell into the road just ahead of me and went on peaceably when pas a public-house the landlord ran out with a large cudgel and apply it to the head and shoulder of the man with such force as to shatter it in piece when the reason of his conduct was ask he reply that he own slave and he would not permit free black to come into his neighborhood not long after i stop at a public-house near halifax n c between nine and ten o'clock p m to stay over night a slave sat upon a bench in the bar-room asleep the master came in seiz a large horsewhip and without any warn or apparent provocation laid it over", "harden that i could witness with comparative indifference the female writhe under the lash and her shriek and cry for mercy ceas to pierce my heart with that keenness or give me that anguish which they first caus it was not alway that i could learn their crime but of those i did learn the most common was non-performance of task i have seen men strip and receive from one to three hundr stroke of the whip and paddle my study and meditation were almost nightly interrupt by the cry of the victim of cruelty and avarice tom a slave of col n obtain permission of his overseer on sunday to visit his son on a neighbor plantation belong in part to his master but neglect to take a pass upon its being demand by the other overseer he reply that he had permission to come and that his hav a mule was sufficient evidence of it and if he did not consider it as such he could take him up the overseer reply he would take him up giv him at the same time a blow on the arm with a stick he held in his hand sufficient to lame it for some time the negro collar him and threw him and on the overseer' command him to submit to be tie and whip he said he would not be whip by him but would leave it to massa j they came to massa j s i was there after the overseer had relat the case as above he was blam for not shoot or stab him at once after dinner the negro was tie and the whip given to the overseer and he used it with a severity that was shock i know not how many lashe were given but from his shoulder to his heel there was not a spot unridg and at almost every stroke the blood flow he could not have receive less than well laid on but his offence was great almost the greatest known lay hand on a white man had he struck the overseer under any provocation he would have been in some way disfigur perhap by the loss of his ears in addition to a whip or he might have been hung the most common cause of punishment is not finish task but it would be tedious mention further particular the negro has no other inducement to work but the lash and as man never acts without motive the lash must be used so long as all other motive are withheld hence corporeal punishment is a necessary part of slavery punishment for runaway are usually severe once whip is not sufficient i have known runaway to be whip for six or seven night in succession for one offence i have known other who with pinion hand and a chain extend from an iron collar on their neck to the saddle of their master' horse have been driven at a smart trot one or two hundr mile being compel to ford water cours their driver accord to their own confession not abat a whit in the rapidity of their journey for the ease of the slave one tie a kettle of sand to his slave to render his journey more arduous various are the instrument of torture devis to keep the slave in subjection the stock are sometime used sometime block are fil with pegs and nail and the slave compel to stand upon them while stop on the plantation of a mr c i saw a whip with a knot lash lying on the table and inquir of my companion who was also an acquaintance of mr c s if he used that to whip his negro oh says he mr c is not severe with his hand he never whip very hard the knot in the lash are so large that he does not usually draw blood in whip them it was principally from hear the conversation of southern men on the subject that i judge of the cruelty that is generally practic toward slave they will deny that slave are generally ill treat but ask them if they are not whip for certain offence which either a freeman would have no temptation to commit or which would not be an offence in any but a slave and for non-performance of task they will answer promptly in the affirmative and frequently have i heard them excuse their cruelty by cit"]
